titulo.alumno: «Una giornata a Bologna»: combining timetables, routes and conditions

intro: Understand a complete cultural visit programme combining timetables, landmark places and adjustments for weather.

piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: guided visits, itineraries and contingencies

frases.estudio: Il gruppo arriva a Bologna alle nove e venti e lascia i bagagli in albergo, vicino a Piazza Maggiore.
frases.alumno: The group arrives in Bologna at nine twenty and leaves its luggage at the hotel, near the Piazza Maggiore.
analisis: leaves its luggage at the hotel

frases.estudio: La visita guidata comincia alle undici; chi arriva dopo può raggiungere il gruppo al museo.
frases.alumno: The guided tour starts at eleven; anyone who arrives later can join the group at the museum.
analisis: La visita guidata comincia alle undici
the guided tour starts at eleven
join the group at the museum

frases.estudio: A pranzo è previsto un tavolo alle tredici, ma ognuno paga ciò che ordina.
frases.alumno: A table is planned for lunch at one o'clock, but everyone pays for what they order.
analisis: A pranzo è previsto un tavolo
a table is planned for lunch
everyone pays for what they order

frases.estudio: Nel pomeriggio il programma prevede il mercato coperto.
frases.alumno: In the afternoon the programme includes the covered market.
analisis: in the afternoon the programme includes

frases.estudio: Se piove, la passeggiata sotto i portici sarà più lunga e il parco verrà visitato domenica.
frases.alumno: If it rains, the walk under the arcades will be longer and the park will be visited on Sunday.
analisis: la passeggiata sotto i portici sarà più lunga
the walk under the arcades will be longer
the park will be visited on Sunday

frases.estudio: Il ritorno è fissato per le diciotto e trenta dalla stazione centrale.
frases.alumno: The return is set for six thirty from the central station.

pregunta.texto: Where is the hotel where the group leaves its luggage located?

opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «lascia i bagagli in albergo, vicino a Piazza Maggiore».

opciones.texto: Next to the docks of the seaport of Genoa.
opciones.explicacion: The visit takes place in Bologna near Piazza Maggiore.

opciones.texto: In an isolated estate on the outskirts of Milan.
opciones.explicacion: It is in the centre of Bologna.

pregunta.texto: What alternative is offered to people who do not arrive in time for the start of the route?

opciones.texto: Join the group directly in the museum rooms.
opciones.explicacion: It is expressly stated: «chi arriva dopo può raggiungere il gruppo al museo».

opciones.texto: Wait in the hotel lobby until the return in the evening.
opciones.explicacion: They can join at the museum.

opciones.texto: Buy an individual ticket for an opera performance.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the indication given in the itinerary.

pregunta.texto: What rule has been set for paying for lunch at one o'clock?

opciones.texto: Each attendee pays exactly for the items they have ordered.
opciones.explicacion: The document states: «a pranzo è previsto un tavolo alle tredici, ma ognuno paga ciò che ordina».

opciones.texto: The total cost of the meal is included free in the train ticket.
opciones.explicacion: Each person pays for what they order.

opciones.texto: A compulsory fixed-price menu for the whole group is imposed.
opciones.explicacion: Each diner pays for their own order.

pregunta.texto: What adjustment to the itinerary applies if it rains in the afternoon?

opciones.texto: The walk under the arcades is extended and the park visit moves to Sunday.
opciones.explicacion: The plan states: «Se piove, la passeggiata sotto i portici sarà più lunga e il parco verrà visitato domenica».

opciones.texto: The excursion is immediately suspended and the return train is brought forward to midday.
All the areas of the covered market are closed to the public.
opciones.explicacion: The market continues in the programme.

pregunta.texto: At what time is the return transport from the central station arranged to leave?

opciones.explicacion: The itinerary ends: «Il ritorno è fissato per le diciotto e trenta dalla stazione centrale».

opciones.texto: At one o'clock sharp after finishing lunch.
At nine twenty in the morning, to coincide with the arrival.

frase.texto: Il ritorno è fissato per le diciotto e trenta

piezas.traduccion: The return is set for six thirty.
piezas.explicacion: Return time formally recorded in the programme.
